g.text: 4-Stage Borrower Wizard • Server BRE Engine • Role-Guarded Operations Modules (Sales, Sanction, Disbursement, Collection)
Submits payload to Express API ⟶ Creates Loan record with initial status
Applicant redirected to personal loan tracking portal with active loan ledger.
Backend Express Middleware verifies JWT claim & role matching required module.
Frontend guards tab views dynamically according to active session matrix.
LENDING LIFECYCLE FINITE STATE MACHINE & EVALUATOR 1-CLICK MATRIX
• Database Layer: MongoDB Atlas clustered document schemas for Users, Loans, and Payments with atomic status transitions.
• Auditing & Traceability: Every loan record maintains strict timestamps, executive approval IDs, and payment UTR records.
